articles.title: UK banks face 10,000 complaints in 3 months over crypto restrictions
articles.snippet: The U.K. claims to aspire to become a global cryptocurrency hub, an ambition that would appear to be at odds with the attitude to crypto purchases of its major banks.

articles.title: Canada opens consultation on stablecoins, citing US GENIUS Act
articles.snippet: As part of the potential implementation of its Stablecoin Act, the Canadian government will hear from the public on a proposed framework for tokens from non-financial institutions.

articles.title: US senator probes Tether after reported deal with ex-Trump crypto adviser
articles.snippet: The Democratic ranking member of the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations asked Paolo Ardoino for records related to a reported deal between Tether and Nxum.

articles.title: Anthropic Makes IPO Filing Public, Plans Nasdaq Listing Under ‘ANT’
articles.snippet: The S-1 shows revenue up from $1.2 billion a year earlier, and a share structure that leaves a trust and the co-founders in control.

articles.title: Game Publishers Have Pushed to Cut Discs Since 2007, Infinity Ward Veteran Says
articles.snippet: Robert Bowling, who spent six years working on Call of Duty, told Decrypt that Activision suggested cutting discs nearly two decades ago.
